# 續貞元釋教錄

**ID:** T2158
**Volume:** T55
**Category:** 事彙部類
**Original Category:** 目錄部
**Byline:** 南唐 恒安集
**Dynasty:** 南唐
**Date:** 945
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2158

## Contributors
- 恆安 (A000838)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **Southern Tang (南唐) Buddhist canonical bibliographic supplement**, compiled by **Héngān** 恒安 in **Bǎodà** 保大 3, the *yǐsì* year = **945 CE**. The work supplements **Yuánzhào's** *Zhēnyuán xīndìng shìjiào mùlù* ([KR6s0097](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0097), 800 CE) with the post-800 translation activity through the late Tang and Five-Dynasties periods. The byline reads **西都右街報恩禪院取經禪大德恒安集** ("Composed by Héngān, *qǔjīng chán dàdé* of Bàoēn Chán Cloister, the right street of the Western Capital"). Preserved at T55 no. 2158.

**Abstract**

Authorship and date: composed by **Héngān** 恒安 (DILA does not preserve a separate authority entry; otherwise unattested) at the **Bàoēn Chán Cloister** 報恩禪院 in the **Western Capital** = **Chángān**, in **Bǎodà** 保大 3 = **945 CE**.

The dating is significant: **Bǎodà** is the era-name of the **Southern Tang** (南唐) regional dynasty (937–975) under **Yuánzōng** 元宗 **Lǐ Jǐng** 李璟 (r. 943–961) — making the work a **Southern-Tang regional** Buddhist canonical bibliography, produced by Buddhist scholars in the Southern-Tang-controlled lower-Yangtze and Jiang-nan region during the chaotic Five-Dynasties period. The use of "**Tang**" in the title — Bǎodà *yǐsì*-year **Dà Táng** — reflects the Southern Tang's claim to be the legitimate continuation of the original Tang dynasty (which had collapsed in 907 in the central plain, but which the Southern Tang regime claimed to have preserved in the south).

*notBefore* = **945**, *notAfter* = **945** (firmly dated). Catalog dynasty 南唐.

The work documents the **post-Yuán-zhào (post-800) translation activity** through the late Tang into the early Five-Dynasties period — a substantial expansion of the canonical roster covering ~150 years of additional translation output, including:

- Late-Tang Esoteric translations (post-Bù-kōng / Prajñā generations).
- Five-Dynasties translation activity in the Southern Tang and other regional courts.
- Liturgical, ritual, and commentarial canonical-additions.

The 1-juan brief format makes this a focused supplement rather than a comprehensive restatement — paralleling **Dàoxuān's** 1-juan supplement [KR6s0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0089) to his own main *Dà Táng nèidiǎn lù* ([KR6s0088](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0088)).
